column1: 30751§tempo§ˈtempəʊ§n. （音乐的）速度；拍子；（活动、生活的）节奏§In a study of the effects of music tempo (as measured in beats per minute, or bpm) during exercise, participants jogged outdoors for 30 minutes while listening to Beyoncé’s “Irreplaceable” (88 bpm) continuously.§在一项关于运动时音乐**节拍**（以每分钟拍数 bpm 计）影响的研究中，参与者一边连续听碧昂丝的《Irreplaceable》（88 bpm），一边在户外慢跑 30 分钟。§Many believe that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, contain some acoustic features that are universally calming to infants.§许多人相信，以缓慢**节拍**为特征的摇篮曲，含有对婴儿普遍具有安抚作用的声学特征。§§music tempo 音乐节拍；the tempo of change 变化的速度§§

30752§palette§ˈpælət§n. 调色板；用色范围；色彩组合；（可选的）全部手段§Artists’ palettes—the surfaces on which painters arrange and mix their paints—can provide valuable insights into the painters’ creative processes.§艺术家的**调色板**——画家在上面排布、调和颜料的平面——能为了解画家的创作过程提供宝贵线索。§Contrasting a high saturation color palette against dark paper and stoneware, Atlanta-based artist Jiha Moon creates fused pieces, wherein Korean folk art, Western contemporary art, and global popular culture mix.§以高饱和**配色**对照深色纸张与炻器，驻亚特兰大的艺术家 Jiha Moon 创作出融合之作：韩国民间艺术、西方当代艺术与全球流行文化在其中交汇。§§a limited color palette 有限的色彩组合；color palette 配色§§改译文：原译是另一句（简化人物配有限色彩）的翻译，按英文重译

30753§expenditure§ɪkˈspendɪtʃə§n. 支出；开支；花费；（时间、精力的）耗费§… by Reason, 2003-2005 — Percentage of total penalty — Reason for tax penalty: self-dealing, undistributed income, taxable expenditures, excess business holdings§……按原因分列，2003–2005 年——占处罚总额的百分比——税务处罚原因：自我交易、未分配收入、**应税支出**、超额企业持股§§§§taxable expenditures 应税支出；public expenditure 公共支出；expend v. 花费；消耗§比 expense 更正式，常指机构、政府层面的开支§改例句：原文是图表文字的 OCR 乱码（刻度数字、重叠的图例残片、■□ 符号、后接不相干的正文残句），整理为图表标题、坐标轴与图例；改译文：原译是图表说明加另一句正文，按整理后的英文重译

30754§clergy§ˈklɜːdʒi§n. （统称）神职人员；教士；牧师§Charles James is the son of a high-ranking clergy member. Charles James was an exact and careful boy; he never committed himself; he well knew how much was expected from the eldest son of the Archdeacon of Barchester; and was therefore mindful not to mix too freely with other boys.§查尔斯·詹姆斯是一位高级**神职人员**的儿子。他是个一丝不苟、行事谨慎的男孩，从不轻易表态；他深知作为巴切斯特副主教的长子，人们对他期许有多高，因此留心不与其他男孩过分厮混。§§§§clergy member 神职人员；clergyman n. 教士；牧师§集合名词，单复数同形；与 laity（平信徒）相对§

30755§contempt§kənˈtempt§n. 轻视；蔑视；鄙视；（法）藐视§… was something to be repudiated with contempt, like a mirror trick.§……是该被**轻蔑**地否弃的东西，就像镜子戏法一样。§§§§with contempt 轻蔑地；contempt for 对…的蔑视；contemptuous adj. 轻蔑的；contemptible adj. 可鄙的§说 contempt for 而非 contempt to；contemptuous 是「表示轻蔑的」，contemptible 是「可鄙的」§改译文：原译是整段的翻译，只留对应这半句的部分（mirror trick 是「镜子戏法」）

30756§cue§kjuː§n. 线索；提示；暗示；信号 v. 给…提示§Researchers Ximena Bernal and Priyanka de Silva wondered if the calls alone are sufficient for midges to locate the frogs or if midges use carbon dioxide emitted by frogs as an additional cue to their prey's whereabouts, like mosquitoes do.§研究者 Ximena Bernal 与 Priyanka de Silva 想知道：仅凭鸣声是否足以让蠓找到青蛙，还是蠓会像蚊子那样，把青蛙排出的二氧化碳当作定位猎物的额外**线索**。§In the wild, crustose coralline algae (CCA) promote growth in the healthy reefs they inhabit by releasing lipids and other metabolites—chemical cues that trigger coral larvae settlement.§在野外，壳状珊瑚藻通过释放脂质与其他代谢物——触发珊瑚幼虫附着的化学**信号**——促进其栖居的健康珊瑚礁的生长。§§an additional cue 额外的线索；chemical cues 化学信号；on cue 恰在此时；cue the music 示意放音乐§§

30757§retailer§ˈriːteɪlə§n. 零售商；零售店§For example, a marketing study simply trying to identify the average amount customers spend per transaction at an online retailer has a straightforward central question that doesn’t require many years of data collection.§例如，一项只想弄清顾客在某网络**零售商**处每笔交易平均消费额的营销研究，其核心问题十分直接，并不需要多年数据收集。§But in one of the experiments, Sevilla and Townsend arranged the same jewelry with different levels of intervening space at an upscale retailer (Tiffany & Co.) and a relatively inexpensive retailer (Forever 21).§在其中一项实验里，Sevilla 与 Townsend 把相同的珠宝以不同的间距陈列，分别放在高档**零售商**（蒂芙尼）和相对平价的零售商（Forever 21）。§retail 零售 → retailer§online retailer 网络零售商§与 wholesaler（批发商）相对§

30758§textile§ˈtekstaɪl§n. 纺织品；织物 adj. 纺织的§When using hairy coneflower for dyeing cloth, textile artists first soak it in water to release its color.§用毛金光菊染布时，**纺织**艺术家首先把它泡入水中以释出颜色。§Developed in the Edo period (1603‑1868) in Japan to mend clothing and domestic textiles, sashiko uses tightly spaced rows of stitching to beautify and reinforce worn cloth.§刺子绣于江户时代（1603-1868）创于日本，本为修补衣物与家用**织品**，以细密成排的针脚美化并加固磨损的布料。§§textile artist 纺织艺术家；textile industry 纺织业§§

30759§naive§naɪˈiːv§adj. 天真的；幼稚的；轻信的；缺乏经验的；素朴的§When the 50-second-long film Arrival of the Train—which depicts what its title says, a train pulling into a station—was first shown publicly in 1896, spectators, naive to the new medium of film and seeing a train appearing to come directly at them, leaped from their seats and fled the room.§1896 年，那部 50 秒的影片《火车进站》——内容正如片名所说，一列火车驶入车站——首次公开放映时，观众对这种新生的电影媒介**毫无概念**，看到火车仿佛直冲自己驶来，纷纷从座位上跳起、逃出放映厅。§Our belief that the coming of film was transformative is so strong that we invented and keep retelling a founding myth that divides cultural history into a (naive) “before” and (sophisticated) “after.”§我们对「电影的到来具有变革性」这一信念如此强烈，以至于发明并不断重述一个奠基神话，把文化史切成（**素朴**的）「之前」与（成熟的）「之后」。§§naive to 对…毫无经验（或概念）；naivety n. 天真§与 gullible（易受骗的）不同；席勒美学中 naive（素朴的）与 sentimental（感伤的）相对§

30760§behold§bɪˈhəʊld§v. 看；注视；看见（书面、古雅）§Once again Do I behold these steep and lofty cliffs, Which on a wild secluded scene impress Thoughts of more deep seclusion; and connect The landscape with the quiet of the sky.§我又一次**凝望**这些陡峭高耸的崖壁，它们在一片荒野幽僻的景致上，印下更深的幽居之思，并把这片山水与天空的宁静连成一体。§§§§beholder n. 观看者（beauty is in the eye of the beholder 情人眼里出西施）§古雅、文学化；behold! 看哪！§

30761§reckon§ˈrekən§v. 认为；料想；估算；计算§The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University's Nasher Museum of Art was the first to focus entirely on North Carolina artists since the exhibition Across County Lines four years earlier.§杜克大学纳舍尔艺术博物馆 2022 年的展览《Reckoning and Resilience》（意为「**清算**与韧性」），是自四年前的《Across County Lines》以来首个完全聚焦北卡罗来纳州艺术家的展览。§Any assessment of the state of contemporary poetry must reckon with the professionalization of the field.§任何对当代诗歌现状的评估，都必须**直面**这一领域的职业化。§§reckon with 应对；考虑到；reckon sth to be 认为某物是…；reckoning n. 清算；估算§§改译文：展览名后补注中文义，以便标出本词

30762§spatial§ˈspeɪʃl§adj. 空间的；与空间有关的§Because research tends to focus on large-scale effects in cities, decision-makers may be unaware that those outcomes are not always generalizable across spatial scales.§由于研究往往聚焦城市中的大规模效应，决策者可能并不知道这些结果未必能跨**空间**尺度推广。§Animal dispersers may congregate at varying distances from parent trees, may carry seeds for varying lengths of time, and may have idiosyncratic spatial trajectories.§动物传播者可能在距母树不同距离处聚集，携带种子的时长各异，行进的**空间**轨迹也各有癖性。§§spatial scales 空间尺度；spatial trajectories 空间轨迹；spatiality n. 空间性§与 temporal（时间的）相对§

30763§complement§ˈkɒmplɪment§v. 补充；与…相配；使完善 n. 补充物；（语法）补语§A two-dimensional photograph, however, cannot capture how a building interacts with its surroundings, whether by complementing, blending in with, or perhaps even clashing with sights and activities nearby.§然而，一张二维照片无法呈现建筑与周边环境的关系——它是与近旁的景物和活动**相得益彰**、融为一体，还是格格不入。§Computational models can be used to analyze biological mechanisms, complementing the findings of direct experimentation.§计算模型可用于分析生物机制，与直接实验的发现**互为补充**。§§complementary adj. 互补的§与 compliment（称赞）同音异义§改例句：two- dimensional 删去多余空格

30764§incumbent§ɪnˈkʌmbənt§adj. 在任的；现任的；原有的；（作为义务）落在…身上的 n. 现任者；在职者§Based on the data, the researchers concluded that growth of the manufacturing sector in these counties during this period mainly occurred outside incumbent cities.§基于这些数据，研究者得出结论：这一时期这些县制造业的增长主要发生在**原有**城市之外。§§§§incumbent cities 原有城市；be incumbent on sb 是某人的职责§§原书错：be incumbent on sb 里 incumbent 是形容词，原书标成名词

30765§credible§ˈkredəbl§adj. 可信的；可靠的；令人信服的§When communications researcher Sungkyoung Lee and her colleagues tested messages seeking volunteers for clinical trials, however, they found that participants in their study judged recruitment messages from former trial volunteers as significantly more credible than messages from doctors (i.e., credentialed experts).§然而，当传播学研究者 Sungkyoung Lee 及同事检验招募临床试验志愿者的信息时，他们发现，研究参与者认为由曾参加试验的志愿者发出的招募信息，显著比医生（即具有专业资质的专家）发出的信息更**可信**。§§§§credibility n. 可信度§与 credulous（轻信的）、creditable（值得称赞的）区分§

30766§immortal§ɪˈmɔːtl§adj. 不朽的；永生的；流芳百世的 n. 不朽人物；神§… fresh and fair; All palpitating from the master’s hand, The last touch of his chisel lingering there. “And surely this shall last!” he proudly thought; “Fixed in immortal marble is my fame!” Just here …§……清新而秀美；周身仿佛还带着匠人之手的余温，凿刀最后一触仍留在那里。「这必定永存！」他自豪地想，「我的声名已镌入**不朽**的大理石！」就在这里……§§§§immortality n. 不朽；永生；immortalize v. 使不朽§反义词是 mortal（会死的）§改例句：诗行换行处漏空格（fair;All、hand,The、there.“And、thought;“Fixed、fame!”Just）；改译文：删去英文没有的首尾诗行译文

30767§memoir§ˈmemwɑː§n. 回忆录；（个人经历的）记述§Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green.§《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇**回忆录**》（Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge）是 Elleanor Eldridge 与 Frances Harriet Whipple Green 于 1838 年写成的历史记述。§§§§§与 autobiography 不同：memoir 侧重特定经历与时代，不求涵盖一生§

30768§offspring§ˈɒfsprɪŋ§n. 后代；子女；（动植物的）幼崽§Vertical gene transfer involves the transmission of genetic material from a parent to offspring; horizontal gene transfer, on the other hand, involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship.§垂直基因转移指遗传物质由亲代传给**子代**；而水平基因转移则指并非亲子关系的生物之间交换遗传物质。§After the eggs hatch, the noncuckoo parents will typically raise the cuckoo chicks as if they were their own offspring, even if the cuckoos look very different from the other chicks.§蛋孵化后，被寄生的宿主父母通常会像养育亲生**后代**一样抚养杜鹃雏鸟——即便它们的长相与其他雏鸟大相径庭。§§parent-offspring relationship 亲子关系§单复数同形；与 descendant 相比更偏生物学语境§

30769§continuity§ˌkɒntɪˈnjuːəti§n. 连续性；连贯性；延续；（影视）镜头衔接§The percent of cities and towns in a given period that persist from a prior period (backward continuity) and the percent that persist into a later period (forward continuity) are known to correlate positively with economic and political stability in a region.§一个时期内的城镇中，从上一时期延续下来的比例（后向**延续性**），以及延续到下一时期的比例（前向延续性），已知与一个地区的经济政治稳定性呈正相关。§A student writing a paper for a film-studies class contends that Schoonmaker’s priority was to focus scenes around the actors’ performances and that she therefore prioritized performance over surface continuity.§一位为电影研究课写论文的学生主张：Schoonmaker 的首要考量是让场景围绕演员的表演展开，因此她把表演置于表面**连贯性**之上。§§cultural continuity 文化延续；continuous adj. 连续的§与 coherence（逻辑连贯）不同；反义词 discontinuity 断裂§改译文2：删去英文没有的「斯科塞斯剪辑师」，「电影课写论文」补全为「为电影研究课写论文」

30770§render§ˈrendə§v. 使成为；使处于（某状态）；提供；给予；翻译；演绎§The student claims that California's climate renders irrigation an essential component of agriculture in some parts of the state but not in others.§这名学生主张，加利福尼亚的气候**使得**灌溉在该州部分地区成为农业的必要条件，而在另一些地区则不然。§Knurled and twisted, rendered birdlike by age, they luxuriated in the sun’s comfort.§它们疙疙瘩瘩、虬曲盘绕，因年深日久而**变得**颇似禽鸟，正惬意地晒着太阳。§§render sth + adj./n. 使…成为；render assistance 提供帮助；render into English 译成英语；rendering n. 演绎；表现§§改译文：「使」改「使得」以便标出本词；改译文2：补出 rendered 对应的「变得」

30771§variant§ˈveəriənt§n. 变体；变种；变异型 adj. 不同的；变异的§The researchers found that small domestic dogs (e.g., Yorkshire terriers) as well as small wild canids (e.g., foxes) tend to have a particular variant, known as the C allele, of the gene IGF1, a growth-related gene found in all mammals.§研究者发现，小型家犬（如约克夏㹴）以及小型野生犬科动物（如狐狸）往往带有一种特定**变体**，称为 C 等位基因，位于 IGF1 基因上——这是所有哺乳动物都具有的一个与生长相关的基因。§§§§§与 variation（变化、变异程度）区分；基因语境指「变异型」（如等位基因）§

30772§curb§kɜːb§v. 抑制；控制；约束 n. 约束；控制；（美）路缘§While many initiatives aimed at limiting atmospheric warming focus on curbing emissions of methane (CH₄), a greenhouse gas that is typically generated by microbially mediated processes, Lisa Y.§尽管许多旨在限制大气变暖的举措聚焦于**遏制**甲烷（CH₄）——一种通常由微生物介导的过程产生的温室气体——的排放，Lisa Y.……§§§§curb emissions 遏制排放；put a curb on 对…加以约束§「路缘」英式拼作 kerb§改译文：原译漏了同位语「通常由微生物介导的过程产生的温室气体」和 Lisa Y.

30773§subjective§səbˈdʒektɪv§adj. 主观的；个人的；主观臆断的§How we define a neighborhood and its boundaries is subjective, so the team used a clustering algorithm to locate dense groupings of amenities that represent human-identified neighborhoods like Boston's Central Square.§我们如何界定一个街区及其边界是**主观**的，因此团队使用聚类算法，定位出代表人们心目中的街区（如波士顿的中央广场）的密集设施群。§§§§subjectivity n. 主观性§与 objective（客观的）相对§改译文：Central Square 是「中央广场」，原译「联合广场」不对

30774§eternity§ɪˈtɜːnəti§n. 永恒；永生；无穷无尽的时间§Exultation is the going Of an inland soul to sea, —Past the houses, past the headlands, Into deep eternity! Bred as we, among the mountains, Can the sailor understand The divine intoxication Of the first league out from land?§欢腾，是内陆的灵魂出海远航——越过房屋，越过海岬，驶入**永恒**的深处！我们生于群山之间，水手能否领会初离陆地一里格时那份神圣的沉醉？§§§§eternal adj. 永恒的；for an eternity 极长时间§与 forever 相比更庄重、更具哲学意味§改例句：诗行换行处漏空格（headlands,Into、mountains,Can）

30775§rivalry§ˈraɪvlri§n. 竞争；对抗；敌对§This was the case for both dog rivalry and energy but was especially pronounced for chasing, which can be seen when a dog pursues small animals like birds or squirrels.§在「犬只间**竞争**」与「兴奋度」这两个行为类别上情况都是如此，而在「追逐」上尤为明显——狗追赶鸟或松鼠等小动物时就可见到这种行为。§§§§rival n. 竞争者；对手 v. 与…匹敌；sibling rivalry 手足之争§比 competition 更强调「对立情绪」§改译文：原译把 chasing（追逐）换成了「依恋」「寻求关注」，按英文改正

30776§definitive§dɪˈfɪnətɪv§adj. 确定的；最终的；权威性的；最佳的§Mackey's long song's open-endedness is essential to the way it manifests discrepant engagement—that is, the work's associative logic and resistance to linear narrative prevent readers from imposing a definitive and coherent interpretation on its presentation of world cultures.§Mackey 的长歌所具有的开放性，对它体现「不协调的介入」（discrepant engagement）的方式至关重要——也就是说，作品的联想式逻辑与对线性叙事的抗拒，使读者无法对其呈现的世界诸文化强加一个**确定**而连贯的解读。§§§§a definitive interpretation 定论式的解读；definitive edition 权威版本§与 definite（明确的）近义，但 definitive 更含「权威、终极」意味§改例句：engagement-that is.the 改为 engagement—that is, the，onits 补空格；改译文：原译漏了破折号前的前半句，补译

30777§accord§əˈkɔːd§n. 一致；协议；条约 v. 给予；（与…）一致§Canada, which, according to international indices, has relatively strong democratic institutions and low intranational income inequality, experienced an inflation rate of 2.26% in 2018, whereas Oman, which shows the opposite pattern on such indices, had an inflation rate of only 0.88% that year.§**根据**国际指标，加拿大拥有相对强有力的民主制度，国内收入不平等程度较低，2018 年通胀率为 2.26%；而阿曼在这些指标上呈现相反的模式，当年通胀率却仅为 0.88%。§According to journalist Graeme Wood, Bloom claimed to have read Crowley's novel Little, Big at least forty-six times, and in his posthumously published afterword to a 2022 edition of the book, Bloom called himself its "lifelong enthusiast" and described it as a "masterwork."§**根据**记者 Graeme Wood 记述，Bloom 声称至少把 Crowley 的小说《Little, Big》读过 46 遍；在其身后出版的 2022 年版跋文中，Bloom 自称该书「终生的拥趸」，并称之为「杰作」。§§in accord with 与…一致；of one’s own accord 自愿地；accord sb respect 给予某人尊重；according to 根据；in accordance with 依照§according to 由 accord 而来，两句例句都是此形§改例句2：右引号前多余空格；改译文2：「据」改「根据」以便标出本词
